name: リーダーの確認コメントと承認帯
prompt:
Make one minimal geometry correction to reference 1 for LH11-0023. Reference 1 is the current candidate and controls the corrected surface colors and exact content. Reference 2 is the current rendered mock and controls the exact 640×231 frame, Japanese typography, and component geometry.

Preserve every word and state exactly: リーダーの確認コメント; 奉仕時間を確認しました。; 合計 4時間30分; 承認する; 承認して次へ. Keep the send arrow, one divider, total line, and both approval actions.

Match reference 2's positions and sizes for the heading, comment field, send arrow, divider, total text, and bottom buttons. In particular, restore the lower divider and approval row to the mock's vertical positions and restore both button widths/heights to the mock's geometry. Keep the compact horizontal layout and alignment.

Keep the corrected colors from reference 1: white comment field, white secondary 承認する button with a fine neutral outline, and forest-green primary 承認して次へ button. Do not reintroduce the mint secondary fill from reference 2.

Do not change wording, font hierarchy, input content, total, icon identity, background, or other spacing. Add no new content or decorative chrome. Return only the component at the same 640×231 aspect ratio.
reviewNotes: Parent inspected and approved the exact stored candidate. Detailed private production evidence is retained locally.
